title: cupania frutescens
intro: Cupania frutescens, commonly known as Cupania, is a plant species belonging to the family Sapindaceae. It is traditionally used in folk medicine for its medicinal properties, providing various health benefits such as reducing inflammation and improving cardiovascular health. The therapeutic actions of Cupania frutescens include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial effects, which contribute to its healing properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other compounds that exhibit these therapeutic actions, making it a valuable resource in traditional medicine.
